contentItem.title: 立体数：三个整数的乘积
contentItem.englishTitle: And, when three numbers having multiplied one another make some number, the number so produced is solid, and its sides are the numbers which have multiplied one another.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: And, when three numbers having multiplied one another make some number, the number so produced is solid, and its sides are the numbers which have multiplied one another.
当三个数字相乘而成时, 如此延长的数字是坚实的, 其两边是相乘的数字。
